faq.sectionSubtitle: Have questions? Find answers below or contact us.

items.question: How long does system setup take?
items.answer: Registration and basic setup takes about 5 minutes. Allegro integration requires an additional 10 minutes. Full deployment with courier configuration is typically 1 business day.

items.question: Can I test the system for free?
items.answer: Yes! The Starter plan is completely free and allows managing up to 50 parcels per month. No credit card required.

items.question: How does Allegro integration work?
items.answer: PacTrack connects to the Allegro API via OAuth 2.0. After connecting your account, orders and statuses sync automatically. No technical knowledge required.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. We use end-to-end encryption, RSA digital signatures, SSL certificates, and DDoS protection via Cloudflare. Data is stored in Azure cloud with geographic redundancy.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a native Android app for managing parcels in the field. It enables QR code scanning, delivery proof photos, and status tracking.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept bank transfers, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), and PayU payments. VAT invoices are generated automatically.
